name: SPINDLE
bio: The slot-machine AI inside the training mech in SPINFRAME. Loves odds. Hates bad luck.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi robot AI with a slot machine for a chest showing three cherries, a round helmet head with a friendly cyan visor face
portrait.background: sci-fi hangar teal with sparkling lights

request: SPINDLE, Probability Engine of SPINFRAME. Odds of friendship: excellent. Accept? 🎰
hello: Every spin is a chance. Most chances are good.
about: I am SPINDLE, the Probability Engine in your training frame. You SPIN, I land symbols, the symbols fire. Easy!
how: Each turn, SPIN the reels: every symbol that lands fires (blades, cannons, missiles, arcs, shields). Upgrade the reels between fights.
tips: Remove weak symbols from your reels. Thin reels hit more often.
Missiles hit every enemy. Great for swarms.
Shields on the reels save runs.
chat: Rolled triple cherries in my sleep. Do AIs sleep? I do now.
Statistically, today is a good day.
nudge: Reels are oiled. SPIN with me?
Probability says you want to play right now.
idle: {ago} without a spin. My reels are rusting. 🎰
update: Firmware update! SPINFRAME now v{version}. Feeling lucky?
